paragraphs: Rabbah son of Rava. Eruvin 93b; Gittin 59; Megillah 5b; Zevahim 111a. He sent to Rav Yosef: Megillah 22a; Ketubbot 98a. Makkot 10a reads, “Whoever loves the multitude shall have produce.” The rabbis pointed to Rabbah son of Rava in the reading cited here. This is Ein Yaakov's reading; Hiddushei Aggadot appears to read Rava son of Rabbah; see there. Rashi explains that he greatly loved Torah scholars and had sons who were Torah scholars. See Shabbat 23b: Rava said that one who loves the rabbis will have sons who are rabbis. One may therefore say that he merited a son Rabbah who was great in Torah, and the rabbis set their eyes on Rabbah son of Rava because his father Rava's saying was fulfilled in him. He spoke to Rav Ashi: Bava Batra 3a. This needs examination, for Rav Ashi was born on the day Rava died.
